name: Auto Head Gear
author: Henning Berge
description: The Sonic Summoner and the O2 Mask work as soon as you own them, as if worn, like in later Ratchet & Clank games. The headgear you put on stays on after a death, a planet change or a load, like the boots.

settings.name: Sonic Summoner when owned
settings.description: The sand mice answer the Sonic Summoner without it on Ratchet's head.

settings.name: O2 Mask when owned
settings.description: The O2 Mask keeps out Blarg's toxic gas and the gas of Rilgar's extermination robots without it on Ratchet's head.

settings.name: Keep chosen headgear on
settings.description: The headgear you put on in the Items menu, or none, stays as you chose after a death, a planet change or a load, like the boots. The game still puts the O2 Mask on by itself where it must.
